question: In January 2025, which organisation has launched a National Mission on Sustainable Packaging Solutions?
solution: The correct answer is __**CSIR (Council of Scientific and Industrial Research)**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)** is a premier national R&D organization in India, known for its pioneering research in various fields of science and technology. • In **January 2025**, CSIR launched a **National Mission on Sustainable Packaging Solutions** to address the growing environmental challenges posed by non-biodegradable and single-use packaging materials. • The mission aims to develop **eco-friendly, biodegradable, and recyclable packaging alternatives** to reduce environmental pollution and promote sustainability. • Through this initiative, CSIR collaborates with industries, academia, and policymakers to **design and implement packaging solutions** that align with global sustainability goals. • The mission is part of India's broader strategy to achieve its **climate and environmental targets**, including commitments made under the **Paris Agreement**.
